name: week
title: Steward desk
subtitle: Recorded metadata and evidence, not a live source scan

sections.title: Review queue
sections.sql: select * from review_queue order by review_due nulls first,name

sections.title: Owner workload
sections.sql: select * from owner_workload order by owner

sections.title: Latest quality observations
sections.sql: select name,rule,checked_on,examined,failed,failed_percent from quality_latest order by name

sections.title: Evidence gaps
sections.sql: select name,rule,finding from compliance_checks order by name,rule

sections.title: Definitions missing
sections.sql: select a.name as asset,f.name as field from fields f join assets a on a.id=f.asset_id where f.description='' order by a.name,f.name
